name: froncort-workspace
description: Froncort Unified Org Workspace — Support Hub + Review & Audit Console monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n identity,ticket,pr,audit,support-hub,review-console -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,red "npm run dev -w packages/identity-service" "npm run dev -w packages/ticket-service" "npm run dev -w packages/pr-service" "npm run dev -w packages/audit-service" "npm run dev -w frontend/apps/support-hub" "npm run dev -w frontend/apps/review-console"
scripts.prisma:generate: npm run prisma:generate -w packages/identity-service && npm run prisma:generate -w packages/ticket-service && npm run prisma:generate -w packages/pr-service && npm run prisma:generate -w packages/audit-service
scripts.prisma:migrate: npm run prisma:migrate -w packages/identity-service && npm run prisma:migrate -w packages/ticket-service && npm run prisma:migrate -w packages/pr-service && npm run prisma:migrate -w packages/audit-service
